# AI-Syed Jalal

AI-Syed Jalal is a professional AI workspace for chat, research, coding, data analysis, documents, AI agents and multi-model workflows.

Primary site: https://sjalalhs7.github.io/employee-register/

Core capabilities:
- AI chat and multi-model workflows
- Research and analysis
- Code and development workflows
- Data management and analysis
- Document generation and printing
- AI agents and orchestration
- Provider/API integrations
- Operations, security and audit controls

The public website is a static frontend hosted on GitHub Pages. Shared multi-PC authentication and central database features require the separately deployed backend/API.
